categories.main_business_segments: Mingguan New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy sector focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of advanced composite film materials. Its main product lines include photovoltaic (solar) cell backsheet materials, photovoltaic encapsulation films, lithium battery aluminum-plastic films, and special protective films. The company also provides integrated packaging solutions for solar cells and lithium batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as functional polymer film technology, special adhesive development, material surface treatment, optical material design, precision coating and lamination, and functional material dispersion. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including multi-layer film composite and dry heat lamination for aluminum-plastic films. R&D efforts focus on high-performance, high-reliability composite films suitable for N-type solar cells and lithium-ion battery packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large global photovoltaic module manufacturers and lithium battery producers, including strategic clients like JA Solar, Hanwha, BYD, Tongwei, and others. The company serves the solar energy and lithium battery industries, targeting markets for solar cell backsheets, encapsulation films, and lithium battery packaging materials used in electric vehicles, energy storage, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Mingguan New Materials operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jiangxi Province and manufacturing bases in Suzhou, Hefei, and overseas in Vietnam. The company serves domestic and international markets, with significant sales to overseas customers in Southeast Asia, the United States, Turkey, and other regions. Overseas production capacity expansion in Vietnam supports global market demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, specializing in the production of advanced packaging materials for solar cells and lithium batteries. It supplies critical components such as backsheets, encapsulation films, and aluminum-plastic films to downstream module and battery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include leading technology innovation in N-type solar cell packaging materials, expanding encapsulation film capacity, and developing new products like heterojunction solar cell carrier films and perovskite photovoltaic encapsulation films. The company emphasizes R&D investment, talent acquisition, and collaboration with academic institutions to enhance product performance, reduce costs, and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of photovoltaic backsheet materials, encapsulation films, lithium battery aluminum-plastic films, and related composite materials. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some distribution for aluminum-plastic films. Revenue recognition follows product delivery and customer acceptance, including domestic and export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Mingguan New Materials is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the photovoltaic packaging materials sector, holding a top-tier market share in backsheets and a strong position in encapsulation films. It faces intense competition due to industry price pressures and technology iterations. The company maintains competitive advantages through proprietary technologies, national standard leadership, and strategic partnerships with major solar and battery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 864 million, a 38% decline from the previous year, mainly due to reduced demand and price competition in solar backsheets. Net loss attributable to shareholders was RMB 67 million. Despite short-term declines, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, with overseas production ramp-up and product mix adjustments aimed at long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Mingguan New Materials emphasizes its role as a reliable new materials partner providing high-quality, innovative, and green composite films tailored for advanced photovoltaic and lithium battery applications. Its products offer superior durability, environmental resistance, and enhanced photovoltaic efficiency, supported by strong intellectual property and national standard contributions. The company differentiates itself through integrated packaging solutions, technological leadership in N-type solar cell materials, and commitment to sustainable development.
